evidence.description: Direct access to URLSession.shared as a default parameter

candidates.explanation: The `fetchAndUpdate` method directly accesses the `URLSession.shared` singleton as a default parameter, creating a hard-coded dependency on a global service.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

candidates.explanation: The `latestMonth` and `latestReport` properties are mutable instance state reachable through a visible global shared instance (`FinancialReports.shared`), but they are not isolated by an actor or synchronization boundary beyond the actor's own scope (which allows internal mutation but doesn't prevent external access via the shared instance if not properly guarded).
candidates.title: Shared Mutable Instance State Without Isolation
